# pr-1063: gh-1061 Blocked-rework comment: thread dump drowns response.md, and null-id machine notices make the gh-957 coverage gate unsatisfiable (live: dart gh-395 week-long loop)

## Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

## PR Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.

### Fix

- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).

- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

- **Title**: gh-1061 Blocked-rework comment: thread dump drowns response.md, and null-id machine notices make the gh-957 coverage gate unsatisfiable (live: dart gh-395 week-long loop)
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1061` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +433
- **Deletions**: -25
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T19:38:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T20:47:53Z

## PR Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

A single `coverage` object (or a small `blockedContext`) would make call sites self-documenting and prevent the next follow-up from needing a 12th arg. Internal and single-caller today, so purely optional — worth doing before the next touch of this path. --- ### Thread 6 — `js/pushReworkChanges.js` line 1566 **dmtools-factory-bot** (2026-10-18): 💡 **SUGGESTION: the fold's "…and N more" remainder renders differently from the 3 previews** The first 3 unaddressed threads are rendered as `- label` (bulleted, code-formatted), but the remainder via `lines.push(threadShortLabel(t, 32))` — plain text, no bullet, no ``. Inside the `
` block the full list therefore alternates between two formats. Consider wrapping the remainder lines the same way (`- ' + threadShortLabel(t, 32) + '`) so the expanded list is uniformly formatted. Purely cosmetic. --- ## General PR Comments **dmtools-factory-bot[bot]** (2026-10-18): 🚨 **BLOCKING: CI failing — CRAP ratchet rejects 3 new over-threshold functions** The Quality workflow's `crap` check fails on this PR (run 39159678077, exit code 2; the log was fetched via dmtools since `ci_failures_full.log` could not be retrieved): ``` CRAP Ratchet ============ NEW > 8 js/pushReworkChanges.js::threadShortLabel: 10.5 NEW > 8 js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js::runCase: 14.1 NEW > 8 js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js::file_read#20: 11.1 0 regression(s), 3 new over threshold, 3 improvement(s), 0 removed ``` The repo's CRAP threshold is 8 and the ratchet only allows pre-baseline offenders; every function introduced by this PR must land at ≤ 8. The established remediation pattern is in recent history (gh-1036–gh-1039 are all `[CRAP]` split PRs): extract helpers until each new function drops under the threshold. Suggested split for `threadShortLabel` — extract the id-resolution and body-snippet steps: ```javascript function shortThreadId(t) { var id = t.threadId || (t.rootCommentId !== null && t.rootCommentId !== undefined ? 'comment#' + t.rootCommentId : 'no-id'); id = String(id); return id.length > 16 ? id.substring(0, 13) + '...' : id; } function capLen(s, cap) { return s.length > cap ? s.substring(0, cap - 3) + '...' : s; } function threadShortLabel(t, maxLen) { if (!t) return '(unknown thread)'; var body = String(t.body || '').split('\n')[0].trim(); return capLen(shortThreadId(t) + (body ? ' — "' + body + '"' : ''), maxLen || 40); } ``` `runCase` (14.1) and the inline `file_read` mock (11.1) in `test_pushReworkChanges.js` need the same treatment — e.g. extract the `cli_execute_command` git-stub and the `file_read` path-dispatch into named suite-level helpers. CI will not go green until all three are ≤ 8. --- **dmtools-factory-bot[bot]** (2026-10-18): 💡 **SUGGESTION: `totalOpenCount` is returned but never consumed** `buildReplyCoverage` now returns `totalOpenCount: open.length`, but no production caller reads it — the only reference is the new unit test asserting its value. Either wire it in (e.g. the blocked-comment fold could report "N open in total, M addressable" so the header count and the fold stay reconcilable) or drop the field to keep the coverage contract minimal. As-is it is dead API surface that future readers must assume is load-bearing. --- **dmtools-factory-bot[bot]** (2026-10-18): 💡 **SUGGESTION: blocked-comment header counts all open threads, the gate counts addressable only — the numbers can disagree** The gate now runs on `replyCoverage.openCount` (addressable only, gh-1061 AC3), but the blocked path still passes `openInputThreads.length` (ALL open threads, null-id machine notices included) into `handleReworkBlocked`. # pr-1063: gh-1061 Blocked-rework comment: thread dump drowns response.md, and null-id machine notices make the gh-957 coverage gate unsatisfiable (live: dart gh-395 week-long loop)

## Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

## PR Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.

### Fix

- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).

- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

## PR Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

# pr-1063: gh-1061 Blocked-rework comment: thread dump drowns response.md, and null-id machine notices make the gh-957 coverage gate unsatisfiable (live: dart gh-395 week-long loop)

## Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

## PR Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {
---

## PR Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

## PR Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

blocks.text:
# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1063
- **Title**: gh-1061 Blocked-rework comment: thread dump drowns response.md, and null-id machine notices make the gh-957 coverage gate unsatisfiable (live: dart gh-395 week-long loop)
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1061` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +433
- **Deletions**: -25
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T19:38:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T20:47:53Z

## PR Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

# pr-1063: gh-1061 Blocked-rework comment: thread dump drowns response.md, and null-id machine notices make the gh-957 coverage gate unsatisfiable (live: dart gh-395 week-long loop)

## Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {
---

- **Title**: gh-1061 Blocked-rework comment: thread dump drowns response.md, and null-id machine notices make the gh-957 coverage gate unsatisfiable (live: dart gh-395 week-long loop)
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1061` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +433

- **Created**: 2026-10-18T19:38:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T20:47:53Z

## PR Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

'comment#' + t.rootCommentId : 'no-id'); id = String(id); return id.length > 16 ? id.substring(0, 13) + '...' : id; } function capLen(s, cap) { return s.length > cap ? s.substring(0, cap - 3) + '...' : s; } function threadShortLabel(t, maxLen) { if (!t) return '(unknown thread)'; var body = String(t.body || '').split('\n')[0].trim(); return capLen(shortThreadId(t) + (body ? ' — "' + body + '"' : ''), maxLen || 40); } ``` `runCase` (14.1) and the inline `file_read` mock (11.1) in `test_pushReworkChanges.js` need the same treatment — e.g. extract the `cli_execute_command` git-stub and the `file_read` path-dispatch into named suite-level helpers. # pr-1063: gh-1061 Blocked-rework comment: thread dump drowns response.md, and null-id machine notices make the gh-957 coverage gate unsatisfiable (live: dart gh-395 week-long loop)

## Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

- **PR #**: 1063

- **Title**: gh-1061 Blocked-rework comment: thread dump drowns response.md, and null-id machine notices make the gh-957 coverage gate unsatisfiable (live: dart gh-395 week-long loop)
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1061` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +433
- **Deletions**: -25
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T19:38:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T20:47:53Z

## PR Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

# pr-1063: gh-1061 Blocked-rework comment: thread dump drowns response.md, and null-id machine notices make the gh-957 coverage gate unsatisfiable (live: dart gh-395 week-long loop)

## Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

- **Title**: gh-1061 Blocked-rework comment: thread dump drowns response.md, and null-id machine notices make the gh-957 coverage gate unsatisfiable (live: dart gh-395 week-long loop)
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1061` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +433

## PR Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix

blocks.text:
# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

## PR Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

blocks.text:
# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

## PR Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

blocks.text:
# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

- **Title**: gh-1061 Blocked-rework comment: thread dump drowns response.md, and null-id machine notices make the gh-957 coverage gate unsatisfiable (live: dart gh-395 week-long loop)
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1061` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4

- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T20:47:53Z

## PR Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

# pr-1063: gh-1061 Blocked-rework comment: thread dump drowns response.md, and null-id machine notices make the gh-957 coverage gate unsatisfiable (live: dart gh-395 week-long loop)

## Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

--> END ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/review_state.md — reviewer verdict + decision state (CHANGES_REQUESTED = blocking)"] P7["7️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 --> P7 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Already-addressed / invalid threads (gh-957 audit-resolve) The thread list in `pr_discussions.md` / `pr_discussions_raw.json` comes from the SAME GraphQL reviewThreads census the SM armer counts (gh-957) — if it lists threads, they are really open on GitHub and each one needs exactly one reply entry in `outputs/review_replies.json`. A reply entry does NOT always imply a code commit: - **Already addressed** — verify against the current head; cite the commit/file/line that covers the finding. - **Invalid finding** — explain precisely why it does not apply to this code. When every open thread has a targeted reply and the pass pushed no commits, the post-action resolves the threads with an explanatory audit line (rework run URL) per thread — this is the ONLY permitted resolution-without-changes path. Partial coverage resolves NOTHING: the pass is reported blocked. Never leave an open thread without a reply entry. ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph TDD["TDD for PR Rework — RED-GREEN-REFACTOR"] T0["Start from the concrete issue: a CI failure, a review thread, or a BLOCKING/IMPORTANT finding"] T1["RED: Write or extend a test that REPRODUCES the reported issue

## PR Description

Closes #1061
### Root Cause
- The blocked-rework PR comment inlined every unaddressed thread via `threadLabel()` before the agent's text, so on blocked passes the actionable message was buried (live: 39-thread dump on dmtools-dart PR #420) or silently absent when the leg wrote no `outputs/response.md`.
- The gh-957 coverage-gate denominator counted threads with no stable id (`threadId` and `rootCommentId` both absent — machine notices), which can never receive a targeted reply, making the gate unsatisfiable → the gh-395 week-long blocked loop.

### Fix
- `js/pushReworkChanges.js`: new `buildBlockedReworkComment` — ⚠️ header, then `outputs/response.md` verbatim, thread evidence moved into a collapsed `<details>` fold (3 previews + "…and N more", hard-capped labels via `threadShortLabel`, full list inside); missing response.md produces an explicit "agent wrote no response.md — see run log <url>" sentence.
- `buildReplyCoverage` now splits open threads via `isUnaddressableThread` (`threadKeyOf() === null`); the gate denominator counts addressable threads only; null-id notices are reported as informational context in the fold.
- `runLapGate` feeds the addressable counts into `evaluateAuditResolveGate` (semantics for addressable threads unchanged) and passes the notice list to `handleReworkBlocked`.
- `instructions/pr_rework/output_rules.md` + `prompts/pr_rework_prompt.md`: added the AC5 sentence — ALWAYS write `outputs/response.md`, even when blocked; nothing in the run log reaches the human otherwise.

### Test Coverage
- 12 new tests in `js/unit-tests/test_pushReworkChanges.js`: comment composition (AC1/AC2/AC4), coverage denominator (UT-2/UT-4 + addressable-via-rootCommentId case), and action-level gate (UT-1 39-thread < 2000 chars, UT-2 all-null-id not blocked, UT-4/REG-1 mixed still blocks, AC4 placeholder).
- `test_pushReworkChanges.js`: 127 passed, 0 failed; full node harness: 5089 passed, 31 failed — the 31 failures are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (unrelated harness/env issues).

### Notes
- A thread without `threadId` but with a `rootCommentId` remains addressable (replies can target it via `inReplyToId`) and stays in the denominator — only id-less threads are exempt.
- `handleReworkBlocked` now takes a 10th arg (`unaddressable`); all call sites updated (single caller: `runLapGate`).
